newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM gold ends lower on heavy long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM gold ends lower on heavy long liquidation.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo gold futures extended early losses to end lower on Monday, as private investors, facing margin calls, rushed to liquidate their long positions, Japanese traders said.
The firmer yen against the dollar also dampened market sentiment, traders said, adding further losses were likely.
Gold prices ranged from 24 yen to 37 yen per gram lower. Benchmark June was off 26 yen at 1,146 yen.
Gold opened lower in Tokyo after bullion tumbled to 12-year lows in London on Friday. Active selling pushed most gold futures down by their 40 yen per gram limit during the day.
